C202.notes: SER NA-GT-002. Photo confirmed · user shorthand 2010 Guatemala. Reverse Maya stela · 10 CENTAVOS · MONOLITO DE QUIRIGUA (Quiriguá site). Date on arms side (user: 2010). Everyday quetzal change — market / bus / tienda — with a Classic Maya monument in the pocket. Country #31 — first Guatemala / Central America after Costa Rica C016 / NA-CR-001. SER sibling: NA-GT-001 (1934 Ag). Guatemala flips now 2.

C235.notes: SER NA-GT-001. Both sides photo-confirmed (Joseph: This is both sides). Arms · Quetzal · crossed rifles/swords · laurel · REPUBLICA DE GUATEMALA · 0.720 · 1934 // Quetzal on column · LEY DE 26 DE NOVIEMBRE DE 1924 · 10 · CENTAVOS. Junk Ag = melt (@ ledger $63.50/oz; see SILVER.md). Ubico-era silver market / bus change while the Quetzal law of 1924 still named every ten-cent piece. Second Guatemala after C202 / NA-GT-002 (2010 Quiriguá CuNi) — silver bookend decades earlier. Soft beat 1600 locks on this piece. Vault Ag ~63.16 → ~63.24 oz. Guatemala flips now 2.
